headline: President Clinton changed an earlier executive order, No. 12981, which deals with how the government handles export license reviews.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12981, an earlier 1995 order on how federal agencies review applications to export certain goods and technology. The title alone does not say what specific changes were made, so the details of this amendment are not clear from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that review export license applications
who_it_affects.how: They may have to follow updated rules or steps from the earlier order, though the specific changes are not described in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 12, 1996; the effective date is not stated in the available information.
